A plug-in unit can be of various types as shown in Fig. 1 and 2 and It usually consists of a printed board assembly with ( Part 2 ). or without connector(s), handle(s), ejector(s), front panel, rear panel, mounting rails and covers. A plug-in unit can itself house a plurality of different types of plug-in units.

NOTE

This standard ( Part 2 ) is based, without any technical change, on IEC Pub 297-3 ( 1984 ) `Dimensions of mechanical structures of the 482'6 mm ( 19 in ) series : Part 3 Subracks and associated plug-in units' issued by International Electrotechnical Commission. 11
